# Mount Kailash Rejuvenation Centre

> Caribbean clinical bush medicine from Saint Lucia. Wholesale botanicals, retail herbal apothecary, immersive healing retreats, and certified herbal physician training led by Rt Hon Priest Kailash K Leonce (21+ years of clinical herbal practice).

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Mount Kailash and its four pillars — wholesale, apothecary, retreats, school.
- [Wholesale](/wholesale): Caribbean botanical wholesale with COA documentation for clinics, retailers, and wellness brands.
- [Apothecary / Shop](/shop): Wildcrafted herbal tinctures, capsules, teas, and raw herbs from Saint Lucia.
- [The Answer](/the-answer): Signature immune elixir formulated with Anamu, Vervain, and Soursop leaves.
- [Retreats](/retreats): 7-day immersive cellular detox and wellness retreats in the volcanic highlands of Saint Lucia.
- [Webinars](/webinars): Free live and on-demand herbal medicine webinars with Priest Kailash.
- [Herbal Physician School](/school/herbal-physician): Clinical bush medicine training program; 500+ graduates worldwide.
